scope: Actual unchanged published worker and PostgreSQL dispatch, with explicitly selected synthetic processor hooks. Not actual-provider or signing qualification. Seed one valid target and queued job before startup; never edit running jobs, schedules, clocks, leases or application code. Python loader syntax is legacy-only: native compiler-boundary proof is separate.
target_sql: SELECT jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'config_version',config_version,'last_success_present',last_succeeded_at IS NOT NULL,'worker_id',metadata->'worker_id') FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_targets WHERE id='target-review' AND organization_id='org-review'
job_row_sql: SELECT to_jsonb(j) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_jobs j WHERE id='worker-validation-job'
target_row_sql: SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_targets t WHERE id='target-review' AND organization_id='org-review'
